summary: When I was running all the social media channels for @scsu #GearUpworks I tried to build in all the #indieweb tools into our system. The one thing I missed would have been SMS syndication. When working with kids and parents often, fighting data caps, SMS has the greatest penetration. I ended up using @RemindHQ wonder if they would play nice.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: When I was running all the social media channels for @scsu #GearUpworks I tried to build in all the #indieweb tools into our system. The one thing I missed would have been SMS syndication. When working with kids and parents often, fighting data caps, SMS has the greatest penetration. I ended up using @RemindHQ wonder if they would play nice.
